references.text: The Lord's command regarding the cleansing and consecration of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron now carry out in obedience.
The Israelites did everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses - the same formula of obedience is used here.
The Israelites carried out all the work just as the Lord had commanded Moses - a parallel formula of obedience at the completion of the tabernacle.
Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him - the same pattern of obedience to God's command.
The Levites were given to Aaron and the priests to serve at the tabernacle, which is now fulfilled.
Everything that the Lord commands must be kept exactly without addition or subtraction - the principle of obedience to God's word.
